Container.Name: mcp-journiv
Container.Overview: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that connects Claude to your self-hosted Journiv journal. Claude can only see and edit entries you have tagged "ai" — everything else stays private. Exposes list/get/search/create/append/update tools. Talks to Journiv over the REST API only.

Config.Name: AppData Path
Config.Description: Where to store persistent config. Settings are saved here so they survive container updates.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Port the MCP server listens on. Point your cloudflared tunnel route (journalmcp.your-domain) at this port.

Config.Name: Journiv URL
Config.Description: INTERNAL address of Journiv's API — NOT its public Cloudflare-Access hostname. Use the Journiv container name on a shared Docker network (http://journiv:8000) or the Unraid host IP (http://192.168.x.x:8000). The MCP must be able to reach this from its network.

Config.Name: Journiv MCP User
Config.Description: Email of a DEDICATED Journiv account for the MCP (not your personal login). Create it, then re-disable signups in Journiv.

Config.Name: Journiv MCP Password
Config.Description: Password for the dedicated Journiv MCP account. Only needed on first run; saved to AppData afterward.

Config.Name: Required Tag (allowlist)
Config.Description: Only entries carrying this tag are visible to Claude, and every entry the MCP creates gets it automatically. Leave as 'ai' unless you want a different opt-in tag.

Config.Name: MCP Client ID
Config.Description: OAuth client ID used when configuring the Claude remote MCP connector. You can leave this as 'mcp-journiv'.

Config.Name: MCP Auth Token (Secret)
Config.Description: Secret token protecting your MCP endpoint. The MCP hostname has NO Cloudflare Access policy, so this is the boundary. Set a long random string (openssl rand -hex 32) and use the same value in Claude. Do not leave blank if internet-reachable.
